summary: FirstGroup plc provides public transport services in the United Kingdom. It operates through First Bus and First Rail segments. It operates a fleet of approximately 6,000 buses and coaches, as well as 320 trains. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
summary_fr: FirstGroup plc fournit des services de transports publics au Royaume-Uni. Il opère sur les segments First Bus et First Rail. Elle exploite une flotte d'environ 6 000 bus et autocars, ainsi que 320 trains. La société a été fondée en 1986 et est basée à Londres, au Royaume-Uni.
